claims.disproof_condition: 條件：Meta 後續發表寫出 LPO 退出量產或下一代改回 retimed pluggable。核查頻率：每次 OCP 高峰會與 OFC（每年兩次）。觸發後 48 小時：e1 降 confidence 或提撤回、重讀 LPO 節點（tech:lpo）的需求側。
claims.statement: Meta (buyer) at OCP 2026: its evidence comes from 100G/lane LPO in large-scale production, and the lessons carry forward to next-gen linear (200G/lane LRO/LPO, NPO); in live production, linear runs about 2x fewer interruptions and about 2.6x fewer service-affecting failures than retimed. No LPO module vendor is named.

claims.disproof_condition: 條件：Meta 或另一家雲端業者的一手寫出 LPO 撤回、或擴到更多 hop（後者是加強）；或 200G/lane 以上的 linear 需要回到 retimer。核查頻率：每季（OCP、OFC、雲端業者技術部落格）。觸發後 48 小時：重讀光模組 DSP 層的反向路徑。
claims.statement: Meta (buyer) at OCP 2026: 'the per-module retimer DSP is a repeated tax in power, heat, and cost across millions of links'; with LPO 'no DSP means one fewer class of failure' (the host must own equalization instead). Scope is narrow: 'LPO runs the DTSW-EDSW hop, All the rest are retimed.' — LPO displaces module DSPs on one hop of Meta's fabric in production; every other hop still uses retimed (DSP) optics.

At AI scale, the per-module retimer DSP is a repeated tax in power, heat, and cost across millions of links.
No DSP safety net in the module. The host must own equalization, lost triage capabilities.
At the module level the two optics are on par, so the gain is architectural: no DSP means one fewer class of failure.
